content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Based on the eligibility, candidates meeting the criteria will be called for Interview. Document verification shall be done before the Interview. Merit list will be prepared based on score of Interview with a minimum qualifying marks/ percentage of 60%.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NCRTC Group General Manager / Strategic Planning Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-11-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NCRTC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Capital Region Transport Corporation Limited (NCRTC) for filling up vacant posts on a deputation basis in New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under this notification?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Group General Manager / Strategic Planning within the Strategic Planning department, offering lucrative career opportunities for qualified experienced professionals.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced in this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies notified across the organization, with specific allocations detailed in the official recruitment advertisement document available on their portal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess Any Graduate (Full Time) degree. A Post Graduate Degree or Diploma in Management is preferred as an additional desirable qualification for applicants.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit to apply for NCRTC GGM?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 55 years as on the baseline date of 22 October 2026, ensuring experienced professionals can apply for leadership roles.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary scale offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a competitive salary package under the Industrial Dearness Allowance scale of Rs. 1,20,000 to Rs. 2,80,000 or Central Dearness Allowance scale of Rs. 1,44,200 to Rs. 2,18,200.

faq.question: Q7. What are the crucial online application dates?
faq.answer: The online application window opens on 22 October 2026 and closes on 21 November 2026. Candidates must submit their application and required physical documents before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants must apply online through the official NCRTC website at www.ncrtc.in and subsequently send the printed application form through proper administrative channels via post or hand delivery.

faq.question: Q9. How is the candidate selection process structured?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises document verification followed by a personal interview. Candidates must score a minimum qualifying percentage of 60% in the interview to feature on the merit list.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the final hard copy of the application be sent?
faq.answer: The printout of the online application along with supporting documents must be sent to the Career Cell, HR Department at Gatishakti Bhawan, INA Colony, New Delhi - 110023.
